caption:
THE 3-POINT KING 🎮🏀 December 14, 2021. Madison Square Garden. Steph needs two threes to pass Ray Allen.

• He ties it early in the 1st quarter
• Then SPLASH: No. 2,974
• In 789 games. Ray Allen needed 1,300
• We win 105-96, with Allen and Reggie Miller in the building

Will anyone ever catch our guy? 👇

beats.head: THE CHASE
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: December fourteenth, twenty twenty-one. Madison Square Garden. Our guy needs two threes to pass Ray Allen.

beats.head: NO. 2,974
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: First quarter: he ties it... then, splash. Number twenty-nine seventy-four, in seven hundred eighty-nine games. Ray Allen needed thirteen hundred.

beats.head: WE WIN
beats.vo: We win, one-oh-five to ninety-six, with Ray Allen and Reggie Miller in the building.

beats.head: 3-POINT KING
beats.vo: Will anyone ever catch our guy? Comment below.

facts.claim: Dec 14, 2021 at Madison Square Garden vs the Knicks, Curry, needing 2 threes, made his 2,974th career three (passing Ray Allen's 2,973) to become the NBA's #1 all-time 3-point leader
Curry's 789th career game: 762 games through 2020-21 + 27 in 2021-22 through Dec 14 (ESPN game logs, counted Nov 8 2026); he tied Allen in the 1st quarter
